name: Xu Wei
source:
The current generation of Dragon Priest, Xu Wei holds the highest authority in the First Kingdom. A controversial figure, Xu Wei differs from other priests in that he prioritizes building the kingdom over worshipping the dragons. On the other hand, his charisma and devotion won the adoration of many.

Has a thing for intelligent women.
Food: Phoenix Talon
